subject: Comprehensive Zoning Updates Mapping Workshop
overview: The committee held a hands-on mapping workshop to identify zoning non-conformities and prioritize geographic areas for updated regulations. Members reviewed implementation timelines for priority corridors and discussed strategies for citywide public engagement on future neighborhood-specific changes.

items.title: Zoning Mapping Workshop
items.summary: The committee and public reviewed thematic maps of the city to identify where existing building patterns do not conform to current zoning codes as part of Paper 24-033.

items.title: Workshop Findings and Implementation Timeline
items.summary: The committee discussed findings regarding setback and lot size non-conformities in older neighborhoods and outlined a schedule to introduce draft language for the Salem Street and Mystic Avenue corridors in September. Planning staff provided updates on the Medford Square RFP and upcoming grant-funded studies for West Medford and Wellington Circle, while members emphasized the importance of equitable zoning changes across all city districts.
